name: 6-Axis Gyroscope & Accelerometer
description: Like the inner ear of an acrobat! Measures tilt angles, gravity vector, and rotational spin speed.
realWorldAnalogy: Like the inner ear of an acrobat! Measures tilt angles, gravity vector, and rotational spin speed.
wiringGuidance: Connect VCC (Red) to 5V, GND (Dark Slate) to GND, SCL (Blue) to A5, and SDA (Blue) to A4.
commonMistakes: Leaving the module loose or unfastened, causing extreme noise in accelerometer values.
Connecting AD0 to 5V when using default address 0x68 (AD0 must connect to GND).

miniExperiment.title: Tilt & Gyro Balance Stream
miniExperiment.circuit: VCC to 5V, GND to GND, SCL to A5, SDA to A4.
miniExperiment.expectedOutput: Serial Monitor streams raw 3-axis acceleration vectors that change as you tilt the sensor.
